claims.claim_text: The postwar New York University listing remains unlinked to the indexed William Chidekel.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A 1948 professional membership list includes that name with New York University.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Name agreement alone does not bridge the professional listing to the identifier-backed Army identity.
claims.temporal_assessment: Postwar membership is not evidence of a pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: No NYU employer, librarian role or prewar employment date is published.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Frank R Chiella has an unresolved service-identifier/name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index identifier returns a garbled Army name rather than Chiella; a separate roster names Frank Ralph Chiella without an identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier is an exact match, but the name cannot be corroborated. The roster alone cannot repair the corrupted Army record.
claims.temporal_assessment: No occupation or recruitment chronology is accepted from the conflicting record.
claims.match_notes: The printed source row remains unchanged; Ralph is not adopted as a documented variant. Physical-file review is required.

claims.claim_text: Harold A Childs has conflicting indexed and Army service-identifier evidence.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed identifier returns a different Army name. An exact-name Army candidate has a different number.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The name candidate differs from the printed number in six digit positions, not a demonstrated one-digit typo. Neither external record can be assigned securely.
claims.temporal_assessment: The name candidate is dated 22 January 1943; no occupation or birth year is adopted from either candidate.
claims.match_notes: Preserve indexed T/Sgt and both independent candidates for Box 121 review; do not replace the number or merge namesakes.

claims.claim_text: The wartime Shirley Chidsey biography is a probable identity candidate requiring index linkage.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Foy identifies Chidsey in the Leopoldville OSS operation; the 1946 journal lists Shirley A. Chidsey at Leopoldville.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive name, middle initial and documented OSS context support a probable candidate; no service identifier, birth detail or personnel-file pointer directly bridges the index row.
claims.temporal_assessment: Wartime role and postwar name list do not establish an employer before initial OSS entry.
claims.match_notes: The bookseller editorial-work account is discovery only, not an accepted employer claim. A separate employer lead still requires a lawful full-source or archival review. No relative’s occupation, school attendance or later journalism is assigned.
